The eip will continue to be in effect until all of the common stock available under the eip is delivered and all restrictions on those shares have lapsed, unless the eip is terminated earlier by the company 's board of directors. In january 2016, the company 's board of directors approved an amendment of the eip effective february 3, 2016, such that awards may be granted under the plan until january 31, 2022. Share-based compensation cost is recorded net of estimated forfeitures on a straight-line basis for awards with service conditions only, and on a graded-vesting basis for awards with service, performance and market conditions.
